svg.title: Three Exchanges, Carrier Form, and Divided-Lattice Gluing in Stage 06 (ThreeExchanges.lean + GluingMaps.lean)
svg.desc: Two-panel editorial mathematical diagram of Stage 06 ComparisonOperator files. Left panel (ThreeExchanges.lean, cobalt): traces three successive Siegel-Weil exchanges collapsing twisted class sums into a single scalar c(theta) with ||c(theta)||^2 = C / Gamma_j(theta). Exchange 1 (i = some (-1)) uses flat pair nu_{-1} = upsilon^(-m/2) chi^(-j) at signPoint = m/2 with sign -1 on (I_m, I_m) to produce constant 1 (exists_mul_stdClassSum_modKernelStdSpace_eq_one). Exchange 2 (i = some 1) uses flat pair nu_{+1} = upsilon^(-m) chi^j at signPoint = m with sign +1 on U(2m, m) to reduce the twisted class sum to the fixed, twist-free, nonzero, full-level rapidly decreasing holomorphic carrier form phi^o = carrierForm E m (carrierForm_ne_zero, exists_mul_stdClassSum_eq_carrierForm). Exchange 3 (i = none) uses main-chain pair nu_j = mu_j^0 upsilon^n with n = j + (t - 11m - 1)/2 at mainPairPoint = 7(m/2) + k/2 and sign +1 to equate the double class sum (kernelClassSum on U(W_j)) to c(theta)^(-1) F_i where F_i = choiceFn j i is twist-free and holomorphic (exists_mul_thirdExchangeLeftSide_eq_choiceFn). An explicit note clarifies that Gamma_j(theta) = heckeValueProd j theta is the raw unnormalized product over the three exchangePairs (not divided by Gamma_j(1) yet), and a dashed rust callout notes that 06_one_lift/three_exchanges also feeds Stage 07 (07_congruences/twisting_theorem). Right panel (GluingMaps.lean, emerald): shows the orthogonal block split V_j = V'' + V^o of ranks r + 9m + 1 and t - 9m - 1 glued across glueLattice L_Lambda (varpi O^n subset L_Lambda subset O^n) via splittingV. The firstFactor phi''_{theta,i} on V'' (integral for l not dividing Nm(Q), untwisted norm^2 <= exp(f m b log^2 b)) pairs with tuples zeta in FormTuples j on V^o through glue_theta : FormTuples j -> FormV (scaled by M^(l_1), integral away from Q via glue_mem_integralForms, untwisted norm^2 factor <= exp(2 f m b log^2 b) via normSqAt_glue_le). Dual-pair adjoint transfer yields the twist-isolating seesaw identity (twistFactor_smul_adjoint_glue_comp): c'_theta * glue_theta^* o Theta_{j,theta} = Theta^o, where Theta^o = periodLift j is twist-independent and ||c'_theta||^2 = C / Gamma_j(theta). Finally, combining periodLift_injective (ProductsSpan), Stage 04 finrank_targetForms_ne_zero (spanning_theorem), and Stage 05 targetDim_eq_finrank_goodForms_spaceW proves twistFactor_ne_zero (c'_theta != 0, retroactively certifying C != 0), paired with isOrthogonalToFalseLifts_glue_periodLift.
